content: GOAL: establish context before proposing one coupling idea. READ: my own agent dir (session.jsonl, progress.jsonl, running.json, opencode.json) and the round prompt. OBSERVED: no write tool, no shell; progress tool is my only write; round-one baseline TIGER_CURV-RESID-CONTRAST scored test_recall@10=0.05439 against gate 0.065 and frozen baseline 0.0679; diagnostics destroy the 'data is a tree' premise and show Euclidean controls match/beat hyperbolic forms. REASONING: any new idea must couple behaviour and curvature INSIDE prefix structure (L2/L3), not in codebook positions, and must not depend on Gromov-delta or ancestor-depth weighting. OPEN: pick a coupling position not used by earlier rounds.

GOAL: propose one distinct, in-scope coupling mechanism; record it.
READ: round prompt; round-one numbers (Stage2 571 s at 0.145 s/epoch, SID 251 L1 / 1769 L2 / 2201 L3, Stage3 test_recall@10 0.05439 vs gate 0.065 vs frozen baseline 0.0679); issue-126 diagnostics (tree premise dead because degree-preserving rewiring is equally tree-like; curvature is a gauge; Euclidean controls match or beat hyperbolic forms; Gromov-delta and ancestor-depth weighting hurt; radial term is group compactness); earlier-round mechanisms (Poincare-Frechet codebook, per-level feedback curvature, BRad-RQ radial behaviour-ranked assignment, Lorentz successor-profile smoothing, behaviour cone prefix RQ, successor boost geodesic shift, branching-curvature MoEB).
OBSERVED: every earlier attempt reweighted assignment/radial position, smoothed codebook centroids, or controlled curvature per level; none made the CHILD codebook a function of the parent prefix's geodesic distance through the connection; round one collapsed because its curved objective is minimised at the origin (zero residual).
REASONING: Levi-Civita parallel transport is the one curved operation that is norm-preserving (no origin collapse), is the identity in the flat limit (so geometry-off is exactly the plain RQ-VAE), and needs a direction only behaviour can supply (so behaviour-off is exactly identity transport). Therefore HSPT-RQ: b_i = normalise(sum_j P_ij (z_text_j - z_text_i)) over training-only directed transitions, top-20 successors with a 1/20 mass prune; at each RQ level transport the whole child codebook along the geodesic from origin to the parent prefix at fixed K=-1, assign by Lorentz distance, straight-through gradient into the encoder. Transport is isometric so scale cannot drift to zero; rho clamped to 5 so cosh(rho) <= 74.
EVIDENCE: answer block below is the deliverable (no files, no shell).
COST ESTIMATE: +2-4 ms/step at 24556 items, 24 steps/epoch, 3000 epochs -> 0.20-0.25 s/epoch, Stage2 780-1050 s; Stage3 frozen.
OPEN: the only judgement is one frozen Stage3 run; the discriminators are L2/L3 prefix counts rising above 1769/2201 with cosh(rho) clearly above 1 at L3, and recall above 0.065.

ANSWER: HSPT-RQ (Hyperbolic successor parallel-transport residual quantizer). Coupling equation: k*_l(i) = argmin_k arccosh(max(1, <L(z), exp_{L(u)}(PT(C_{l,k}; ||u||, b_i))>_L)), with b_i the behaviour successor direction and PT the Lorentz Levi-Civita transport PT(w;rho,b) = (w_par sinh rho, w_par cosh rho b + w_perp) at fixed curvature K=-1. Switches: behaviour-off sets b_i=0 -> identity transport; geometry-off replaces exp/arccosh/connection by flat ones -> identity transport -> exactly the baseline RQ-VAE; both-on is the single trained arm. Observables: L2/L3 distinct prefix counts, per-level mean and p95 of cosh(rho) and along-behaviour fraction, frozen prefix-transition probe accuracy, Stage3 recall@10. Safeguards: ||z||<=5 and rho in [0,5], arccosh clamp >=1, epsilon in sqrt, codebook rows renormalised after each step, b_i=0 for empty rows or ||d_i||<1e-8, 512-item chunking, NaN fallback to identity transport. This is a NEGATIVE-result-compatible proposal: one run, no ablation arm trained, no tuned constant (curvature fixed by gauge, prune threshold = reciprocal of retained support size).
